item.title: Claude Code's "extended thinking" is a summary- not authentic thinking
item.description:
📝 com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking Some details worth being aware of: Claude encrypts its reasoning into that signature. Getting the full thinking output requires an enterprise agreement. It isn’t the actual thinking that drove the model’s actions in a session- but a summary of the thinking logic.
🔗 Read more: https://patrickmccanna.net/the-text-in-claude-codes-extended-thinking-output-is-not-authentic/

item.title: Moebius: 0.2B image inpainting model with 10B-level performance
item.description:
📝 While 10B-level industrial foundation models have pushed the boundaries of image inpainting, their prohibitive computational costs severely hinder practical deployment. Operating strictly within the latent space to avoid expensive pixel-space decoding, this strategy dynamically balances multiple gradient-based losses to achieve high-fidelity alignment. Remarkably, Moebius achieves this using less than 2\% of the parameters (0.
🔗 Read more: https://hustvl.github.io/Moebius/

item.title: Die analysis of the 8087 math coprocessor's fast bit shifter (2020)
item.description:
📝 The shifter The role of the shifter is to shift binary numbers left or right, a task with several critical roles in floating-point operations. The shifter is also used to assemble a floating-point number from 16-bit chunks read from memory. Structure of the bit shifter.
🔗 Read more: https://www.righto.com/2020/05/die-analysis-of-8087-math-coprocessors.html
